tools.name: request_outcome
tools.description: Find a reliable procurement plan for an outcome and return one retail quote for confirmation. This does not spend, post, purchase, or invoke anything.

tools.name: confirm_outcome
tools.description: Explicitly confirm a previously returned quote and begin configured funding. This may cause a financial action when funding is enabled.

tools.name: get_outcome
tools.description: Read the current payment, supplier, artifact, verification, and remediation state for an outcome.

tools.name: resume_outcome
tools.description: Idempotently poll or reconcile pending supplier and financial operations for an outcome.
